items.title: [ECG] UPDATE: Invitation to Advisory Events - Discover+ Allied Health 2026 (Tues, 24 Nov 2026)
items.author: Justin Arif Prawiradiraja
items.description:
Dear Students,
Please note that there has been a change to Advisory’s event Discover+: Allied Health. The event will now be held on
Tuesday, 24 November 2026
instead. If you're interested, please register and attend the event at your own accord.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Discover+: Allied Health
I am writing to invite youths affiliated with your organisation to join us at Advisory’s upcoming event, Discover+: Allied Health. Since 14 April 2020, Advisory has hosted a total of over 17,000 attendees across all our online events, where students hear from professionals working in their industries of interest.
If you think the event might add value to youths as they explore career options, please share the details of the events and the attached poster with them. We are excited to welcome all interested individuals, without prior experience or engagement necessary. Successful sign-ups for the following events will receive a confirmation email.
Discover+: Allied Health
Date:
24 Nov 2026, Tuesday |
Time:
7:30pm to 9:00pm
Registration Deadline:
24 Nov 2026, Tuesday |
Time:
7:00pm (GMT+8)
ALLIED HEALTH |
Singapore has firmly established itself as a regional leader in healthcare, with a strong and growing allied health sector that underpins the country's broader vision of accessible, high-quality care for its ageing population. Allied health professionals including physiotherapists, occupational therapists, speech therapists, dietitians, medical social workers, and diagnostic radiographers, among others, play an essential role alongside doctors and nurses in supporting patient recovery, rehabilitation, and long-term wellness.
With Singapore's population ageing rapidly and healthcare needs becoming more complex, the demand for allied health professionals is projected to rise significantly, and the sector has been identified as a key growth area under national healthcare manpower plans. Alongside this, there is a rising need for professionals who can deliver person-centred, multidisciplinary care from diagnosis through to rehabilitation and community reintegration.
Despite the sector's importance, many students may have limited awareness of the diverse career pathways within allied health and lack exposure to the day-to-day realities, skills, and training required to enter this field. Therefore, Advisory hopes to connect students with an interest in such work with professionals in the field through Discover+: Allied Health.
Register at
https://bit.ly/Discover-AlliedHealth26
by
24 November 2026, 7pm
.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Thank you.

items.title: [SNECxVIAC] HCI Going Beyond to Spread Joy and Make a Difference at Toy Buffet 2026
items.author: Cai Yi Tian
items.description:
Thanks to your generosity, our contributions to Toy Buffet, an initiative by Food from the Heart, reached close to 2,000 children from families under the MOE Financial Assistance Scheme. On 13 November 2026, Hwa Chong’s Students’ National Education Council (SNEC) and Values-in-Action Council (VIAC) brought the initiative to fruition, giving these children the opportunity to select toys and receive gifts of their own.
Caption: All ready to distribute the toys!
Caption: A memorable moment with the Minister for Education, Mr Desmond Lee and our Toy Buffet student facilitators!
For our student facilitators, the experience went beyond organising and distributing toys. It provided an authentic opportunity to engage with the community, appreciate the circumstances of others and develop empathy.
As SNEC Vice-President Siow Xuan Ting (26S7A) reflects: “Through our participation, we are able to step up and out into the world to give back and spread joy, becoming agents of change! Seeing the smiles as the children receive their toys reminds us that a little love can go a long way and that together, we can achieve so much with the power of community.”
Caption: Our student facilitators helping the children to find a gift to call their own.
Conceived as part of Hwa Chong’s National Day Celebrations (NDC), Toy Buffet brought this year’s theme, “Majulah Singapura, Go Beyond!”, to life. By making active citizenship central to our celebrations, we encouraged students to translate care and concern for the wider community into meaningful action, experiencing how collective generosity can make a tangible difference in the lives of others.
On behalf of SNEC, the NE Unit and VIAC, we extend our heartfelt thanks to our School Leaders, and all students and staff who donated toys, penned heartfelt messages or supported the initiative in many ways.
Left: A thank you note from a beneficiary to our student facilitators
Right: Smiles all around! A fitting end to a day of spreading joy and making a difference
Thank you for going beyond together as one Hwa Chong community!
Ms Cai
(on behalf of SNEC & VIAC)

items.title: [SSEF 2027] Workshop on report writing and poster
items.author: Chia Wan Jie
items.description:
Calling all HS and College students participating in SSEF 2027 and all College's SSRC members!
A valuable opportunity not to be missed!
We have invited Dr Huang Pei, a scientist from A*STAR , to conduct a special workshop on SSEF report and poster design & presentation. Having served as an SSEF judge since 2021 , Dr Huang brings valuable insights into what makes a strong research report and an effective scientific poster. This is a great opportunity to learn directly from an experienced judge and gain useful tips to strengthen your SSEF submissions!
A sumptuous lunch and refreshments will also be provided, generously sponsored by A*STAR!
As
places are limited, please RSVP by indicating your interest through the Google Form by 17 Nov 2359
:
https://forms.gle/xd5PMPYmyKF1i2Vc6
. This will help us make the necessary catering arrangements.
We
strongly encourage all SSEF 2027 participants
to take advantage of this opportunity. Following Dr Huang Pei's workshop, we also invited Dr Bryan Ng, from A*STAR Institute for Human Development and Potential (A*STAR IHDP) to share his research interests in ageing and his journey as a research scientist.
Please see below for the breakdown of the exciting programme lined up on 30 Nov.
30 Nov, Mon, Venue College, D Block D201
12.30pm to 1.30pm: Lunch
1.30pm to 3.00pm
SSEF Report Writing and Poster Workshop
(Dr Huang Pei)
3.00pm to 3.30pm Refreshments
3.30pm to 4.00pm: Students gather at Dr Ng’s venue
4.00pm to 5.15pm:
Meet the Scientist (Dr Bryan Ng)
*The 2 sharings are compulsory for all SSRC members (please submit the google form as well)
All interested High School and College students are welcome!
Best regards,
Dr Adeline Chia
